sha1_hashes.description: Firebase Android App should have at least one SHA-1 or SHA-256 certificate hash defined for security.
sha1_hashes.rationale: SHA hashes are used to verify the authenticity of your app, preventing unauthorized clients from accessing your Firebase resources. At least one of `sha1_hashes` or `sha256_hashes` must be configured.
